Container.Name: MoneyThistle
Container.Overview:
MoneyThistle: a simple personal money manager for a household, opened in your browser. Accounts and registers, Bills & Deposits, paychecks and paystubs, budgets, reports and a year-end tax report, and automatic backups to a folder and to Nextcloud / WebDAV. No bank connections. English, French, Spanish and Portuguese.
Updates: with the Repository ending in :latest, the Docker tab shows "update ready" for each new release; click it to update (or let an auto-update plugin do it). To stay on one version, change :latest to a version number, like :1.0.0 (only that version) or :1.0 (its fixes too).
Keep it on your home network or Tailscale: never open it to the public internet.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the web page (http://SERVER:PORT, also over Tailscale).

Config.Name: Backups folder
Config.Description: Local backup copies (can be a share, e.g. /mnt/user/backups/moneythistle).

Config.Name: First administrator user name
Config.Description: Used only on the very first start, to create the first sign-in. Everyone else is added under People in the app.

Config.Name: First administrator password
Config.Description: Used only on the very first start (8+ characters). Leave empty to create the first sign-in in the browser instead (do that right away).

Config.Name: WebDAV backup address
Config.Description: Optional. e.g. https://cloud.example.com/remote.php/dav/files/USER/Backups/Money (can also be set in the app).

Config.Name: App addresses
Config.Description: Optional. Addresses shown at the bottom of the app, comma separated (e.g. http://tower:8080/,http://tower.tailnet.ts.net:8080/).

Config.Name: Shown: money data folder
Config.Description: Only shown in the app's Settings. Keep it the same as Money data.

Config.Name: Shown: backups folder
Config.Description: Only shown in the app's Settings. Keep it the same as Backups folder.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id that owns the files (Unraid nobody = 99).
